phase_1.title: Phase 1 · M61 Vulcan Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 20×102mm NATO M50 Series primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 417 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 417 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 1524 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 9-groove bore and accelerates to 1050 m/s (55125 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Rotary Cam Firing & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, six rotating barrels follow a stationary 360-degree helical cam track for continuous firing cycles.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 511-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the M61 Vulcan staged for its 6,000 RPM (100 rounds/sec) cadence.

zh.headline: 通用电气 M61A1 “火神” 20mm 六管航炮：1959 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 通用电气 M61A1 “火神”是现代超音速战斗机近距格斗的绝对王者：液压马达带动六根 20mm 炮管以每分钟 1,000 转高速旋转，配合无链闭环螺旋弹鼓实现每秒 100 发零停顿火力墙与高可靠性电击发。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M61 Vulcan 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1959 年问世的 通用电气 M61A1 “火神” 20mm 六管航炮 由美国通用电气 / 通用动力军械系统主导研制，定位为经典的20mm 航空六管旋转机炮。自 1959 年装备 F-104 星战士以来，M61 火神系列已连续服役逾 65 年，先后武装了 F-4、F-14、F-15、F-16、F/A-18、F-22 以及海军密集阵近防系统。
通用电气 M61A1 “火神”是现代超音速战斗机近距格斗的绝对王者：液压马达带动六根 20mm 炮管以每分钟 1,000 转高速旋转，配合无链闭环螺旋弹鼓实现每秒 100 发零停顿火力墙与高可靠性电击发。 整件装备总长 1,827 mm（全炮总长）、空重 112 kg，成为同期航空重武领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1959 年，美国通用电气 / 通用动力军械系统推出了划时代的通用电气 M61A1 “火神” 20mm 六管航炮。自 1959 年装备 F-104 星战士以来，M61 火神系列已连续服役逾 65 年，先后武装了 F-4、F-14、F-15、F-16、F/A-18、F-22 以及海军密集阵近防系统。 它的核心设计聚焦于6,000 发/分（100 发/秒）超高理论射速，0.5 秒点射即可倾泻 50 发 20mm 炮弹，奠定了其在航空重武发展史中的经典地位。

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 通用电气 M61A1 “火神” 20mm 六管航炮 的机械灵魂在于其「液压外能源驱动六管旋转 · 360° 固定椭圆凸轮闭锁轨道」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，六管旋转簇与 360° 螺旋凸轮轨道同步完成供弹、闭锁、电击发与抽壳循环，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。外能源液压驱动完全无视哑弹，故障弹随转子自动抛出绝不卡炮，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。通用电气 M61A1 “火神” 20mm 六管航炮 采用液压外能源驱动六管旋转 · 360° 固定椭圆凸轮闭锁轨道。在每个击发周期中，六管旋转簇与 360° 螺旋凸轮轨道同步完成供弹、闭锁、电击发与抽壳循环。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了外能源液压驱动完全无视哑弹，故障弹随转子自动抛出绝不卡炮。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 20×102mm NATO M50 Series 弹药规格与 1,524 mm × 6 管（9 条渐速右旋膛线 · 1:20"），最高工作膛压约 417 MPa，可赋予弹头 1050 m/s 的出膛初速与 55,125 J 动能，有效作用距离达 2000 米。
内膛技术特点方面，六根独立冷锻镀铬 20mm 身管以 1,000 RPM 旋转，单管仅承受 1,000 发/分热负荷。同时，双列固定椭圆凸轮轨道同步驱动 6 组独立旋转闭锁枪机循环，令其在 6,000 发/分（每秒 100 发） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 1524 毫米身管与 20×102mm NATO M50 Series 口径，通用电气 M61A1 “火神” 20mm 六管航炮 实现了每秒 1050 米的初速与 2000 米有效射程。六根独立冷锻镀铬 20mm 身管以 1,000 RPM 旋转，单管仅承受 1,000 发/分热负荷，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 511 发容量的无链螺旋供弹鼓与导槽与 115 mm 膛轴设计，通用电气 M61A1 “火神” 20mm 六管航炮 将单发后坐冲量控制在 138 N·s 水平。无链螺旋闭环弹鼓与柔性输弹滑槽在 9G 高过载机动下稳定供弹。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M61 Vulcan
paragraphs: Introduced in 1959 by General Electric / General Dynamics Ordnance in United States, the GE M61A1 Vulcan 20mm Rotary Cannon emerged as a defining 20mm Six-Barrel Rotary Aviation Cannon. Entering service in 1959 on the F-104 Starfighter, the M61 family has served continuously for over 65 years across the F-4, F-14, F-15, F-16, F/A-18, F-22, and naval Phalanx CIWS.

The definitive supersonic fighter cannon for over six decades, the hydraulically driven M61A1 Vulcan spins six 20mm barrels at 1,000 RPM around a stationary elliptical cam track, pairing electric priming with a linkless closed-loop drum for 100 rounds per second. Measuring 1,827 mm (71.9 in Overall) at an unloaded weight of 112 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Aviation & Heavy Ordnance class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1959, General Electric / General Dynamics Ordnance of United States introduced the GE M61A1 Vulcan 20mm Rotary Cannon. Entering service in 1959 on the F-104 Starfighter, the M61 family has served continuously for over 65 years across the F-4, F-14, F-15, F-16, F/A-18, F-22, and naval Phalanx CIWS. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — 6,000 RPM (100 rds/sec) fires 50 twenty-millimeter shells in a half-second burst — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the GE M61A1 Vulcan 20mm Rotary Cannon sits its Hydraulic Externally Driven 6-Barrel Gatling · 360° Stationary Elliptical Cam Track. Throughout every firing cycle, six rotating barrels follow a stationary 360-degree helical cam track for continuous firing cycles, containing 417 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, External hydraulic drive ejects dud primers automatically with zero jam stoppage, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The GE M61A1 Vulcan 20mm Rotary Cannon relies on Hydraulic Externally Driven 6-Barrel Gatling · 360° Stationary Elliptical Cam Track. During each cycle, six rotating barrels follow a stationary 360-degree helical cam track for continuous firing cycles. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: External hydraulic drive ejects dud primers automatically with zero jam stoppage.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 20×102mm NATO M50 Series with 1,524 mm × 6 Barrels (9-Groove Progressive RH · 1:20"), the GE M61A1 Vulcan 20mm Rotary Cannon develops 1050 m/s muzzle velocity and 55,125 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 2000 meters.

Internally, Six cold-forged 20mm barrels spin at 1,000 RPM, distributing 6,000 RPM heat across six tubes. Combined with its 6,000 RPM (100 rounds/sec) tempo, Stationary elliptical cam housing drives six synchronized rotating bolt assemblies, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 20×102mm NATO M50 Series through its 1524 millimeter bore, the GE M61A1 Vulcan 20mm Rotary Cannon achieves 1050 meters per second and 2000 meters of effective reach. Six cold-forged 20mm barrels spin at 1,000 RPM, distributing 6,000 RPM heat across six tubes.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 511-round linkless helical feed drum with a 115 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 138 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Closed-loop linkless helical drum feeds reliably through 9G fighter maneuvers.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-98), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.

Explore BAY-98 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the GE M61A1 Vulcan 20mm Rotary Cannon.
